Achha, toh tumhara favourite hai catch pakadna. Ab ek number line lo, 0 se 1 tak. Upar ise 3 barabar hisson mein kaata hai, neeche 7 mein. Line ka niyam simple hai: zero se jitna door, utna bada. Isi niyam se, 1/8 aur 1/4 ko kisi bhi line par rakho, toh 1/8 zero ke zyada paas rukega: 1/8 < 1/4. Isi line par, zero se zyada door kaun rukega, 1/3 ya 1/7?
